Woke up at 7, tea and toast. Took the 8:20 bus to Wipro office in Hinjewadi, standup at 10, then a code review till 1. Lunch at the cafeteria, two meetings and a bug fix in the afternoon. Left at 6 and reached home by 7:30. Cooked dal and rice, watched an episode and slept at 11.

Visited the passport office in Thane for the document verification. The queue was long, the token number was 214 and they called it by 1 pm. Submitted the forms, paid the fee and collected the receipt. Had a samosa outside and took the train back.

Today i went to the library, issued two books on operating systems and three novels. Sat at the third floor desk till 4 and finished the first chapter. Walked back through the gate near the canteen and ordered a sandwich.

Bought a new SIM card, recharged the old one and updated the address on my aadhaar through the app. Had lunch at the mess and a nap after that. Evening was free so i ironed clothes and cleaned the shelf.
lab at 9, lecture at 12, lunch, project meeting at 3 with Ishaan and Pooja. Notes uploaded on the drive by 6. Dinner at 8 and some gaming till 11.
the bike service took two hours. Changed the oil, replaced the brake pads and cleaned the chain. Paid 1800 and rode home through the highway. Washed the helmet and kept it near the door.
Took the 6 am train from Pune to Mumbai for the workshop at IIT Bombay. Registered at the gate, attended three sessions and had lunch in the campus mess. Left by 5 and was home by 9.
